title: RoboACE: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Robot Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2611.13034v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot agents can improve reusable skills, planning procedures, and recovery strategies from execution feedback, yet a fixed practice source leaves the search for new weaknesses unchanged. Useful practice depends on the agent's current capabilities, so the procedure that chooses practice must also be revisable. We present RoboACE (Robot Adversarial Co-Evolution), a framework that jointly evolves curriculum and execution harnesses around frozen foundation models. The curriculum harness uses accumulated capability evidence to propose informative challenges, while the execution harness responds with reusable revisions that expand execution capabilities. Alternating updates hold one side fixed as the other changes, and admitted challenges form fixed snapshots for comparing execution revisions. translated_title: RoboACE：面向机器人自我提升的对抗性协同进化
translated_abstract: 机器人智能体可以通过执行反馈来改进可复用的技能、规划流程和恢复策略，然而固定的练习来源使得寻找新弱点的过程保持不变。有效的练习取决于智能体当前的能力，因此选择练习的程序本身也必须是可修正的。我们提出了RoboACE（机器人对抗性协同进化），这是一个围绕冻结的基础模型共同演化课程与执行框架的体系。课程框架利用累积的能力证据来提出有信息量的挑战，而执行框架则以可复用的修订作出响应，从而扩展执行能力。交替更新使一方保持固定而另一方发生变化，被采纳的挑战形成固定快照用于比较各执行修订版本。从紧凑的LIBERO练习条件集合出发，所得到的冻结部署优于所评估的控制器和智能体系统。
tldr: RoboACE提出了一种对抗性协同进化框架，让课程生成端与执行能力端围绕冻结的基础模型交替演化，使机器人能够持续发现自身弱点并通过可复用的修订实现自我提升。
en_tdlr: RoboACE introduces an adversarial co-evolution framework where curriculum generation and execution capabilities alternately evolve around frozen foundation models, enabling robots to continuously discover their own weaknesses and achieve self-improvement through reusable revisions.
